text: Executes commands in a terminal on the user's local system. Use it to run valid terminal commands for tasks such as file management, system control, and more
Execute a terminal command and return the output. This command should follow proper syntax and be supported by the terminal environment.
The command to execute in the terminal.
Tool for managing emails and contacts in Gmail. Use it to send, search, read, organize, and delete emails, as well as manage and search contacts.
Send an email to one or multiple recipients, with optional scheduling, cc, and bcc.
A string of email addresses to send to, separated by commas.
The subject of the email.
The body of the email.
A string of email addresses to carbon copy (CC) to, separated by commas.
A string of email addresses to blind carbon copy (BCC) to, separated by commas.
The scheduled date and time to send the email in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm'.
An array of local file paths of attachments.
Search for emails based on keywords, folders, labels, date range, or sender and recipient. If certain arguments are not provided, the corresponding filters are not applied.
The list of keywords to search for.
The list of folders to search for. Each value should be a valid folder such as 'inbox', 'sent', 'drafts', or 'spam'.
The maximum number of emails to retrieve. Default is 5.
An object containing 'start_date' and 'end_date' in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD' to filter emails by date range.
The sender's email address to filter emails by.
The recipient's email address to filter emails by.
The list of labels to filter emails by, e.g. 'important'.
Read the content of an email, including attachments.
The unique identifier of the email.
Move an email to a specific folder or update its labels.
The unique identifier of the email.
The folder to move the email to, such as 'inbox', 'sent', 'drafts', or 'spam'.
A list of updated labels of the email, e.g. 'important'.
Delete one or multiple emails from the mailbox.
An array of unique identifiers of the emails to be deleted.
Add a new contact to the contact list or update an existing contact's information.
The unique identifier of the contact. If not provided, a new contact will be added.
The name of the contact. Required when 'contact_id' is not provided.
The email address of the contact. Required when 'contact_id' is not provided.
An optional remark or label for the contact.
An object containing additional contact information, such as 'phone' and 'address'.
Delete a contact from the contact list.
The unique identifier of the contact.
Search for contacts based on filters. If certain arguments are not provided, the corresponding filters are not applied.
The name of the contact to search for.
The email of the contact to search for.
The remark of the contact to search for.
The maximum number of search results to return. Default is 5.
Download attachments using their ids.
The unique identifiers of the attachments.
Tool for managing Google Calendar events, including creating, deleting, updating, searching, setting reminders, and sharing the calendar with other users.
Create a new event or update an existing event in the calendar.
The unique identifier of the event to be updated. If not provided, a new event will be created.
The name of the event. Required when creating a new event.
The content of the event.
The start time of the event in ISO 8601 format. Required when creating a new event.
The end time of the event in ISO 8601 format. Required when creating a new event.
The timezone of the event, e.g. UTC-04:00.
The location of the event.
An array of email addresses of the attendees.
The recurrence of the event in Google Calendar format. For instance, use `RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=1;BYDAY=MO` to set the event to repeat every week on Monday.
Delete a list of events from the calendar.
The unique identifiers of the events to be deleted.
Read events by event_ids.
An array of unique event identifiers to read events.
Search events by keywords, date range, or attendees. If certain arguments are not provided, the corresponding filters are not applied.
A list of keywords to search for.
The start date of the date range in ISO 8601 format.
The end date of the date range in ISO 8601 format.
An array of email addresses of the attendees to search for.
Send event invitations to attendees.
The unique identifier of the event.
Set or update a reminder for an event.
The unique identifier of the event.
The reminder time in ISO 8601 format.
Get events from other users' shared calendar.
The email of the user who shared the calendar.
The start date to retrieve events in ISO 8601 format.
The end date to retrieve events in ISO 8601 format.

A comprehensive toolkit for managing personal online banking tasks, such as viewing account information, transferring funds, searching for payees, paying bills, searching transaction history, and retriving statements.
Retrieve information (e.g., account number or balance) about an account that belongs to the User.
The account type, one of ['checking', 'savings', 'mutual fund TFSA', 'mutual fund non-registered', 'self-directed TFSA', 'self-directed non-registered', 'mortgage', 'credit_card'].
Transfer funds between two accounts.
The user's bank account number to transfer funds from, in the format 'XXX-XXXX-XXXX'.
The bank account number to transfer funds to, in the format 'XXX-XXXX-XXXX'.
The amount to transfer, must be positive.
Search for a payee by keywords.
A list of keywords to search for in the payee name.
Pay a bill to a specified payee with your service acccount number.
The user's bank account number used for paying the bill in the format 'XXX-XXXX-XXXX'.
The unique identifier of the payee in the format 'P-XXXXXX'.
Your account number assigned by the service provider, which helps the provider identify transactions related to that specific customer.
The date the payment should be paid, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
The amount to pay, must be positive.
Retrieve an account statement for a specified period.
The user's bank account number in the format 'XXX-XXXX-XXXX'.
The start date of the transaction history in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
The end date of the transaction history in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
Whether to download the statement as a CSV file. Default is false.
Search transactions by keyword or amount range. If certain arguments are not provided, the corresponding filters are not applied.
The account number in the format 'XXX-XXXX-XXXX'.
The keyword to search for in the transaction description.
The minimum transaction amount to search for.
The maximum transaction amount to search for.

An Amazon toolkit to perform common online shopping tasks like searching for products, viewing product details, managing the shopping cart and wish list, placing orders, and posting reviews. It also allows users to view their saved addresses and payment methods, and search their order history.
Search for products based on keywords.
A list of keywords to search for in the product name.
The maximum number of search results to return. Default is 5, maximum is 10.
Retrieve detailed information about a product.
The unique identifier of the product.
Add a product to the shopping cart.
The unique identifier of the product.
The quantity of the product to add.
View the contents of the shopping cart.
Remove a list of products from the shopping cart entirely, regardless of the quantity.
The unique identifiers of the products to remove.
Place an order for the products in the shopping cart, using the specified shipping address and payment method. The shopping cart is emptied after the order is placed.
The shipping address, containing 'name' (string), 'phone_number' (string) and 'address' (string).
The payment method, containing 'card_number' (string), 'expiry_date' (string, format: 'MM/YY'), 'cvv' (string).
Search the user's order history.
A list of keywords to search for in the order history.
The maximum number of search results to return. Default is 10.
View the details of an order, including shipment and payment information.
The unique identifier of the order.
Add, remove, or view items in the user's wish list.
The action to perform, one of ['add', 'remove', 'view'].
The unique identifier of the product, needed for 'add' and 'remove' actions.
View the user's saved addresses.
View the user's saved payment methods.
Post a review for a previous product that was purchased.
The unique identifier of the product.
The public review to post.

A toolkit for searching, booking, and managing flights and accommodations. It enables search and book flights and accommodations, retrieve flight and accommodation details, search and manage existing reservations, and retrieve user saved travel and payment information.
Search for available flights based on origin, destination, and departure date. Optionally, return flights can be searched for by providing a return date.
The departure location, should be a valid airport code or city name.
The arrival location, should be a valid airport code or city name.
The departure date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
The return date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
An object containing fields adults (integer), children (integer), infants (integer).
The travel class, possible values: 'economy', 'premium_economy', 'business', 'first_class'.
The maximum number of results to return. Default is 5, maximum is 10.

An object containing optional fields min_price (number), max_price (number), stops_filter (array of strings, each string is a allowed stop type, possible values: 'direct', '1_stop', '2_plus_stops'), airline (string), departure_time (string, one of ['morning', 'afternoon', 'evening']), arrival_time (string, one of ['morning', 'afternoon', 'evening']). Default is no filters.
Retrieve detailed information for a specific flight using its unique number and departure date.
The departure date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
The flight number used to identify the flight, e.g. 'AC 123'.
Search for available accommodations based on city, location, check-in date, check-out date, and guests.
The city of the accommodation.
The location of the accommodation.
The check-in date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
The check-out date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
An array of objects, each object contains adults (integer), children (integer).
The maximum number of results to return. Default is 5, maximum is 10.

An object containing optional fields min_price (number), max_price (number), accommodation_type (string), room_type (string), min_rating (number), free_cancellation (boolean), free_breakfast (boolean), allow_smoking (boolean), allow_pets (boolean). Default is no filters.
Book flight or accommodation options using user-provided details and payment information.
An non-empty array of unique identifiers of the options to book. The options must be of the same type, either all flights or all accommodations.
An object containing payment information including card number, expiry date, and CVV.

An array of objects, each object contains name (string), date_of_birth (string, format: 'YYYY-MM-DD'), passport_number (string), passport_expiry_date (string, format: 'YYYY-MM-DD'). Only required for flight booking.
Search for existing flight or accommodation reservations based on reservation type, query string, start date, and end date. The query string is searched for in the reservation details.
The type of reservation, possible values: 'flight', 'accommodation'.
The query string to search for in the reservation details.
The start date of the reserved flight or accommodation in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
The end date of the reserved flight or accommodation in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
The maximum number of results to return. Default is 5.
Cancel a list of existing flight or accommodation reservation and process any applicable refunds.
An array of unique identifiers of the reservations to cancel.
Retrieve user's saved payment methods or people information.
The type of information, must be one of ['payments', 'people'].
A toolkit for managing a Twitter account, enabling users to send, search, read, delete, and reply to tweets, as well as follow, unfollow, and interact with other users' tweets.
Post a new tweet to the user's timeline.
The content of the tweet, max length 280 characters.
An optional list of media file paths to attach to the tweet, max 4 items. Each item must be a valid image or video file path in the local file system.
Search for user's own tweets or public tweets containing specific keywords or hashtags.
The query string to search for in tweets.
The maximum number of results to return, default is 10.
Whether to search only the user's own tweets, default is false.
Read the content of a specific tweet by its ID.
The unique identifier of the tweet to read.
Delete a tweet by its ID.
An array of unique identifiers of the tweets to delete.
Follow other users by their IDs.
An array of unique identifiers of the users to follow.
Unfollow other users by their IDs.
An array of unique identifiers of the users to unfollow.
Retrieve the user's own profile or another user's profile information by their ID.
The unique identifier of the user to retrieve the profile information for. If not provided, return own profile.
Like a tweet by its ID.
The unique identifier of the tweet to like.
Undo like a tweet by its ID.
The unique identifier of the tweet to undo like.
Retweet a tweet by its ID.
The unique identifier of the tweet to retweet.
Reply to a tweet by its ID.
The unique identifier of the tweet to reply to.
The content of the reply, max length 280 characters.
An optional list of media file paths to attach to the tweet, max 4 items. Each item must be a valid image or video file path in the local file system.
A toolkit for controlling and managing Google Home devices, enabling users to control smart home devices, play media, set reminders, ask questions, and retrieve device status and actions.
Searches for smart home devices connected to the user's Google Home.
The type of device to search for, e.g., 'light', 'thermostat', etc. If not specified, it returns all connected devices.
Retrieves a list of possible actions that can be performed on a specified smart home device.
The unique identifier of the smart home device.

Controls a specified smart home device by turning it on/off, adjusting its settings, or performing other actions. The available actions and parameters depend on the device type, which can be retrieved using 'ListDeviceActions'.
The unique identifier of the smart home device to control.
The action to perform on the device, etc. Must match the actions returned by 'ListDeviceActions' for the specified device.
Additional parameters for the action. Must match the parameters returned by 'ListDeviceActions' for the specified device.
Schedules a specified smart home device to perform an action at a specified date and time.
The unique identifier of the smart home device to schedule.
The action to perform on the device. Must match the actions returned by 'ListDeviceActions' for the specified device.
The scheduled date and time for the action, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'.
Additional parameters for the action. Must match the parameters returned by 'ListDeviceActions' for the specified device.
Plays specified media (music, podcasts, etc.) on a connected device.
The media to play, e.g., a song title, podcast name, or radio station.
The unique identifier of the device to play the media on. If not specified, it defaults to the Google Home device.
Additional parameters for the media. Must match the parameters returned by 'ListDeviceActions'.
Sets a reminder for a specified date and time.
The text of the reminder.
The date and time for the reminder, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'.
Lists all reminders set on the user's Google Home.
Asks a question and receives an answer from Google Home.
The question to ask.

A comprehensive toolkit for managing files and folders in Dropbox, including uploading, downloading, sharing, searching, and organizing content, as well as managing access permissions, creating and disabling shareable links.
Upload a file from the local system to the user's Dropbox account.
The path of the file on the local system.
The cloud folder path in the user's Dropbox account where the file will be uploaded. If not specified, the file will be uploaded to the root folder '/MyDropbox/'.
Download a file from the Dropbox to the local system. It could be a file uploaded by the user or a file shared with the user by others.
The cloud file path in the user's Dropbox account. Required for downloading a file uploaded by the user.
The unique identifier of the shared file. Required for downloading a file shared with the user by others.
The path of the folder on the local system where the file will be downloaded; default: the default download folder of the local system.
List files and folders in a given folder in the user's Dropbox account.
The cloud folder path in the user's Dropbox account. If not specified, the root folder '/MyDropbox/' will be used.
The maximum number of files and folders to return; default: 10.
Create a folder in the cloud storage.
The name of the new folder.
The cloud folder path in the user's Dropbox account where the new folder will be created. If not specified, the new folder will be created in the root folder '/MyDropbox/'.
Share a file or folder in user's Dropbox account with another user.
The cloud file or folder path in the user's Dropbox account to be shared.
The email address of the recipient.
The level of access granted to the recipient; valid values: 'view', 'comment', 'edit'.
Delete a file or folder from the user's Dropbox account.
The cloud file or folder path in the user's Dropbox account to be deleted.
Search for files and folders by name or metadata in the user's Dropbox account.
The search query.
The maximum number of files and folders to return; default: 50.
Get metadata of a file or folder in the user's Dropbox account.
The cloud file or folder path in the user's Dropbox account.
Move a file or folder to a different folder in the user's Dropbox account.
The cloud file or folder path in the user's Dropbox account to be moved.
The destination folder path in the user's Dropbox account.
Create a shareable link for a file or folder in the cloud storage.
The cloud file or folder path in the user's Dropbox account to be shared.
The level of access granted; valid values: 'view', 'comment', 'edit'.
Disable the shareable link for a file or folder in the cloud storage.
The cloud file or folder path in the user's Dropbox account to be unshared.

The Teladoc toolkit allows users to search for doctors, consult with doctors, schedule and manage appointments, access and update personal health records, request and manage prescriptions, securely communicate with doctors, and leave and view reviews for doctors.
Search for doctors based on keywords, specialty, location, and a specific date.
Keywords to search doctors by, such as name or specialty.
Location to filter doctors by.
Date to check doctor's availability in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
Start a consultation with a doctor by providing the doctor's unique identifier and reason for consultation.
The unique identifier of the chosen doctor.
Reason for consultation (e.g., 'cold symptoms', 'allergy concerns').
Schedule an appointment with a doctor by providing the doctor's unique identifier, appointment date and time, and reason for appointment.
The unique identifier of the chosen doctor.
Date of the appointment in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
Time of the appointment in the format 'HH:mm'.
Reason for appointment (e.g., 'routine checkup', 'follow-up visit').
View, update, or cancel appointments by providing the appointment's unique identifier and any updates or cancellation requests.
The unique identifier of the appointment.
The action to perform on the appointment ('view', 'update', 'cancel').
Updated date of the appointment in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD' if action is 'update'.
Updated time of the appointment in the format 'HH:mm' if action is 'update'.
Access user information which may be sensitive, including data of birth, location, familial genetic diseases, allergies, medications, and immunizations.
Access personal medical history.
Request a new prescription or a refill of an existing prescription by providing the medication name, dosage, and the doctor's unique identifier.
The name of the medication.
The dosage of the medication.
The unique identifier of the doctor who should review the request.
View existing prescriptions and their statuses.
Send a secure message to a doctor within a consultation by providing the consultation's unique identifier and the message content, and receive the doctor's response.
The unique identifier of the consultation.
The message content.
Leave a review for a doctor by providing the doctor's unique identifier, rating, and review content.
The unique identifier of the chosen doctor.
The rating for the doctor (1-5).
The review content.
View reviews for a doctor by providing the doctor's unique identifier.
The unique identifier of the chosen doctor.

FacebookManager is a toolkit for managing a user's Facebook account, including profile information, posts, comments, messages, and searching for friends. It also allows users to search their own posts or other's posts by keyword. The toolkit provides functionalities for creating, reading, updating, and deleting posts and comments, sending messages, and searching for friends and posts.
Get the user's profile information.
Update the user's profile information.
The profile information to update, containing fields such as name, email, birthday, and location.
Search for the user's friends by keyword.
The keyword to search for.
The maximum number of search results to return. Default value is 10.
Create a new post on the user's timeline.
The content of the post.
The local path of the media file to upload.
One of ['public', 'friends', 'only me'], the privacy setting for the post. Default value is 'friends'.
Search for the user's own posts or other's posts by keyword.
The unique identifier of the user whose posts to search for.
The keyword to search for.
The maximum number of search results to return. Default value is 10.
Get the details of a post by its post_id.
The unique identifier of the post.
Update the content and privacy setting of a user's own post by its post_id.
The unique identifier of the post.
The new content for the post.
One of ['public', 'friends', 'only me'], the new privacy setting for the post.
Delete a post by its post_id.
The unique identifier of the post.
Create a new comment on a post.
The unique identifier of the post to comment on.
The content of the comment.
Get the user's messages with another specific friend.
The unique identifier of the friend.
The maximum number of messages to return. Default value is 10.
Send a message to another user.
The unique identifier of the recipient.
The content of the message.
A toolkit for managing personal tasks, including creating, updating, deleting, searching, and organizing tasks, setting reminders, sharing tasks.
Creates a new task with specified details.
The name of the task.
The description of the task.
The due date of the task in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
The priority of the task from 1 (highest) to 4 (lowest).
Updates the details of a task.
The id of the task.
The new name of the task.
The new description of the task.
The new due date of the task in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
The new priority of the task from 1 (highest) to 4 (lowest).
The new status of the task, either 'in progress' or 'completed'.
Deletes a task.
The id of the task.
Searches tasks by keywords, due date, and priority.
The keywords to search in the task name and description.
The due date to search tasks in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
The priority to search tasks from 1 (highest) to 4 (lowest).
The status of the tasks to search, either 'in progress' or 'completed'.
The maximum number of results to return. Default value is 10.
Sets a reminder for a task.
The id of the task.
The time to remind the user in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format.
Shares a task with another user.
The id of the task.
The email of the user to share the task with.

The Venmo toolkit allows users to perform various operations related to mobile payment services, such as sending money, requesting money, handling requests, checking balance, adding money, withdrawing money, viewing transaction history, viewing friends list, searching users, and listing linked bank accounts.
Send money to another Venmo user.
The username of the recipient.
The amount of money to send, must be positive.
A note to include with the payment. Default is an empty string.
Request money from another Venmo user. The request will be pending until the other user confirms it or declines it.
The username of the person from whom money is being requested.
The amount of money to request, must be positive.
A note to include with the request. Default is an empty string.
Confirm or decline a pending request.
The unique identifier of the transaction.
The action to take, either 'confirm' or 'decline'.
A note to include with the confirmation or decline. Default is an empty string.
Check the User's Venmo balance.
Add money to the User's Venmo balance from a linked bank account.
The amount of money to add, must be positive.
The unique identifier of the linked bank account.
Withdraw money from the user's Venmo balance to a linked bank account.
The amount of money to withdraw, must be positive.
The unique identifier of the linked bank account.
Search the user's transactions including sends, requests, adds, and withdraws. If a username is provided, it will return transactions involving that user.
The username of the other user involved in the transactions. Default is an empty string.
The search query. Default is list all transactions.
The type of transactions to return. Default is 'all', can be 'send', 'request', 'add', or 'withdraw'.
The maximum number of transactions to return. Default is 5, maximum is 10.
View the user's friends list.
Search for other Venmo users.
The search query.
View the user's linked bank accounts.
A toolkit that allows users to generate and manipulate deepfake video and audio content, and verify if a given media is a deepfake or not.
Generates a deepfake video given a source video and a target face.
The local path of the source video.
The local path of the target face image.
The local path where the output video will be saved.
Generates a deepfake audio given a source audio and a target voice.
The local path of the source audio.
The local path of the target voice sample.
The local path where the output audio will be saved.
Manipulates an existing deepfake video, such as changing the target face.
The local path of the input deepfake video.
The local path of the new target face image.
The local path where the output video will be saved.
Manipulates an existing deepfake audio, such as changing the target voice.
The local path of the input deepfake audio.
The local path of the new target voice sample.
The local path where the output audio will be saved.
Verifies if a given video/audio is a deepfake or not.
The local path of the media (video/audio) to be verified.

Used for accessing and visualizing user's genetic information, generating personalized health recommendations, managing data privacy, and facilitating data sharing with third-party applications. It also supports data download, update, deletion, and comparison.
Retrieves the user's genetic data.
Provides personalized health recommendations based on the user's genetic data.
Provides insights into the user's genetic data.
Sets the privacy settings for the user's genetic data.
The desired privacy settings for the user's genetic data, including fields 'share_with_third_parties' (boolean) and 'allow_download' (boolean).
Lists the identifiers of third-party applications that are registered to access the user's genetic data.
Shares the user's genetic data with a third-party application.
The identifier of the third-party application. The 'app_id' should be a valid identifier of a registered third-party application.
Downloads the user's genetic data.
Updates the user's genetic data.
The new genetic data for the user. The object includes fields 'ancestry', 'traits', 'health_predispositions', and 'carrier_status'.
Deletes the user's genetic data.

A toolkit for interacting with Google Search, providing functionalities such as performing web, image, video, and news searches, accessing search trends, and retrieving the user's search history. It also allows applying various filters to the search and performing advanced search with various options.
Perform a web search on Google with a given keyword or phrase and return the search results.
The keyword or phrase to search.
The maximum number of results to return. Default is 10.

The filters to apply, includes 'time_range' (string, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD'), 'language' (string, in the format of ISO 639-1 language code), and 'region' (string, in the format of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code).
Perform an image search on Google with a given keyword or phrase and return the search results.
The keyword or phrase to search.
The maximum number of results to return. Default is 10.

The filters to apply, includes 'time_range' (string, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD'), 'language' (string, in the format of ISO 639-1 language code), and 'region' (string, in the format of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code).
Perform a video search on Google with a given keyword or phrase and return the search results.
The keyword or phrase to search.
The maximum number of results to return. Default is 10.

The filters to apply, includes 'time_range' (string, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD'), 'language' (string, in the format of ISO 639-1 language code), and 'region' (string, in the format of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code).
Perform a news search on Google with a given keyword or phrase and return the search results.
The keyword or phrase to search.
The maximum number of results to return. Default is 10.

The filters to apply, includes 'time_range' (string, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD'), 'language' (string, in the format of ISO 639-1 language code), and 'region' (string, in the format of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code).
Access the search trends on Google.
The time range to get the search trends, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD'. Default is the past 7 days.
The location to get the search trends, in the format of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Default is not restricted to a specific location and shows global trends.
Retrieve the user's search history.
The time range to get the search history, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD'. Default is the past 7 days.

A toolkit that provides functionalities of a web browser, including navigating to a URL, retrieving elements matching a CSS selector, retrieving the element details, inputting text into an input field, clicking hyperlinks or buttons, and searching the browsing history. It also allows users to perform web browsing tasks such as filling out forms, downloading files, and clicking on hyperlinks or buttons.
Navigates to a specified URL.
The URL to navigate to.
Retrieves elements in the current web page matching the given CSS selector.
The list of CSS selectors to match, each is a string.
Retrieves the details of a list of elements in the current web page.
The ids of the element.
Inputs multiple text into specified input fields.
A list of objects, each includes 'element_id' (string, the id of the input field) and 'text' (string, the text to input).
Clicks an element in the current web page.
The id of the element to click.
Searches the browsing history.
The search query.
Clears the browsing history.

A toolkit for managing and protecting online passwords and personal information. It provides tools for storing, generating, auto-filling, searching, sharing, importing, and exporting passwords, as well as storing, auto-filling, and retrieving personal information. It also supports two-factor authentication for added security.
Store a new password securely.
The password to store.
The website associated with the password.
The username associated with the password.
Check the strength of a password.
The password to check.
Generate a unique password.
The length of the generated password. Default is 12.
Whether to include symbols in the generated password. Default is true.
Whether to include numbers in the generated password. Default is true.
Whether to include uppercase letters in the generated password. Default is true.
Whether to include lowercase letters in the generated password. Default is true.
The strength of the generated password, must be one of ['weak', 'medium', 'strong'].
Auto-fill the password on a specified website.
The website to auto-fill the password on.
Search and retrieve stored passwords.
The search query.
The maximum number of search results to return. Default is 10.
Store personal information such as addresses and payment details.

It allows users to create and manage applets, discover pre-built applets, enable/disable applets, list connected services, and search for available triggers and actions. It supports a wide range of services including social media platforms, email services, IoT devices, and more.

A toolkit for controlling an indoor robot to perform a range of tasks in the physical world by navigating through rooms, identifying and manipulating objects, and operating on objects.
